labors—not in idleness, but in doing, working without weariness, without
pain, while awaiting a glorious resurrection, when they are to have the
privilege of coming back to spend their time on this planet, when it is
celestialized and converted into a heaven. . . . How would a Latter-day Saint answer such a question?

the image of God." We cannot sincerely hold this conviction without
